tips.title: Rearrange your dashboard
tips.body: Press and hold any widget for a moment to pick it up, then drag it where you want it. Your new order is saved automatically.

tips.title: No mouse? Use Customize
tips.body: Press Customize next to the greeting, focus a widget's grip button and use Space and the arrow keys to move it one place at a time.

tips.title: Hide what you don't use
tips.body: While rearranging, tap − on a widget to hide it. Changed your mind? Press Undo in the message that appears.

tips.title: Preview widgets before adding them
tips.body: Settings → Dashboard shows a preview of every widget and of your whole layout on a desktop or a phone, so you can decide before switching one on.

tips.title: Keep an eye on your credits
tips.body: Switch on the Credits widget in Settings → Dashboard to see your balance and plan at a glance, with a shortcut to top up.

tips.title: Start your day with Plans for today
tips.body: The Plans for today widget lists today's sessions from your calendar with a countdown to each one, so you always know what's next.

tips.title: See what people love
tips.body: The Likes & views widget shows the total likes and views of your shared assets and which ones perform best.

tips.title: Ask the assistant from the dashboard
tips.body: Type an idea in the quick prompt and press Enter: the AI assistant opens with your request already on its way.

tips.title: Start over anytime
tips.body: Settings → Dashboard → Reset to default brings back the original widgets and their order in one click.

tips.title: Jump anywhere with ⌘K
tips.body: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows) on the dashboard to search tools, agents and pages without leaving the keyboard.

tips.title: Plan a whole video in one go
tips.body: Use Plan a video: choose the publish date and every production step, from ideation to publishing, is scheduled backwards for you.

tips.title: Reschedule by dragging
tips.body: In the week view, drag a session to another day or hour to move it. No forms needed.

tips.title: Change a session's length
tips.body: Drag the top or bottom edge of a session in the week view to make it shorter or longer.

tips.title: Add a session in one click
tips.body: Click an empty slot in the week view to create a session right at that time.

tips.title: Create your own session types
tips.body: Need a Podcast or Sponsor call type? Create a custom type from the session dialog and give it its own color and icon.

tips.title: Add the platforms you use
tips.body: Publishing on Kick or somewhere else? Add a custom platform so your video projects show where they go live.

tips.title: Never miss a session
tips.body: Set a reminder on each session, or for a whole plan, and you'll get a notification before it starts.

tips.title: Watch for overlaps
tips.body: The planner warns you when two sessions overlap, so you don't book two recordings at the same time.

tips.title: Tick sessions off
tips.body: Mark sessions as done as you finish them: the progress of each video and the calendar totals update at once.

tips.title: Use the agenda on your phone
tips.body: On phones the planner opens on the agenda: a simple list of the next 30 days that's easy to scroll with one thumb.

tips.title: See the big picture in Month view
tips.body: Switch to Month to spot busy weeks and empty gaps before you commit to a new video.

tips.title: Write a real description
tips.body: Use each session's description for shot lists, locations and links: it's what Plans for today shows on your dashboard.

tips.title: Save your production steps
tips.body: Set up your own list of production steps once, and Plan a video will use it, in your order, for every new video.

tips.title: Measure your workload
tips.body: The totals at the top of the planner show your sessions, planned hours and completed work. Use them to plan a realistic week.

tips.title: Dictate your idea
tips.body: In Plan with AI you can speak instead of typing: use the voice button to dictate your video idea.

tips.title: Give the AI your notes
tips.body: Attach up to 5 files (PDF, DOCX, TXT, JSON or Markdown) with your research or brief; the assistant reads them before planning.

tips.title: It learns from your past videos
tips.body: Plan with AI compares your idea with your past productions to estimate how long each step will really take you.

tips.title: Open the suggested tool
tips.body: Each planned step can suggest a platform tool with a ready prompt. Press Open tool and it opens pre-filled.

tips.title: Review before you commit
tips.body: Not sure about the plan? Choose Review and edit to adjust steps and dates before adding anything to your calendar.

tips.title: Know the cost first
tips.body: The AI planner shows what an analysis costs before you run it, and cancelling before it finishes charges nothing.

tips.title: Win the first 3 seconds
tips.body: Open with the most surprising moment, question or result. If viewers don't know why to stay within 3 seconds, they scroll.

tips.title: One video, one idea
tips.body: Short videos that chase a single clear idea are easier to watch to the end and easier to share.

tips.title: Cut every pause
tips.body: Remove silences, repeated takes and slow intros. A tighter edit keeps retention high, and retention is what platforms reward.

tips.title: Change something every few seconds
tips.body: Switch angle, zoom, add text or a sound effect regularly. Small pattern interrupts keep attention from drifting.

tips.title: Always add captions
tips.body: Many people watch without sound. Big, readable captions keep them watching and make your message land.

tips.title: Shoot with vertical in mind
tips.body: For Shorts, TikTok and Reels, keep the subject centered so a 9:16 crop never cuts off what matters.

tips.title: End where you began
tips.body: Endings that flow back into the first second make people watch twice, which boosts replays.

tips.title: Curiosity, not clickbait
tips.body: Promise a clear benefit or an open question in the title, and make sure the video delivers it. Broken promises kill retention.

tips.title: Title and thumbnail work as a team
tips.body: Don't repeat the title in the thumbnail. Let the image show the emotion and the title add the context.

tips.title: Jump on trends early
tips.body: Use X Trend Research to spot rising topics and publish your take while the conversation is still growing.

tips.title: Turn winners into a series
tips.body: When a video performs well, make part 2. Series give viewers a reason to follow you for the next one.

tips.title: Ask for one thing
tips.body: End with a single call to action: comment, follow or watch the next video. Several asks at once get ignored.

tips.title: Reply to early comments
tips.body: Answering comments in the first hour keeps the conversation going and can spark ideas for your next video.

tips.title: Post on a schedule
tips.body: Consistency beats bursts. Use the Content Planner to lock in a publishing day and plan the work backwards from it.

tips.title: One long video, many shorts
tips.body: Run your long videos through the AI Video Analyzer & Smart Clipper to find the best moments and export them as vertical clips.

tips.title: Tell it as a story
tips.body: Setup, tension, payoff. Even a 30-second tip feels more watchable when it has a small story arc.

tips.title: Use negative prompts
tips.body: List what you don't want, like "text, watermark, blurry", in the negative prompt field for cleaner thumbnails.

tips.title: Start from a style
tips.body: Pick a style such as Bold & Colorful, Cinematic or Reaction Face to steer the look, then refine your prompt.

tips.title: Show a clear emotion
tips.body: A close face with a strong, readable emotion draws more clicks than a wide shot where everything is small.

tips.title: Go for high contrast
tips.body: Thumbnails are tiny in feeds. Bright subjects on simple, contrasting backgrounds stand out at any size.

tips.title: Three words or fewer
tips.body: If you add text to a thumbnail, keep it to a few big words. Long phrases become unreadable on a phone screen.

tips.title: Describe the scene, not just the topic
tips.body: Instead of "cooking video", write who is in the frame, what they do, the lighting and the mood. Specific prompts give better images.

tips.title: Generate a few versions
tips.body: Create two or three variations of the same idea and pick the strongest one at a small size.

tips.title: Use the script's thumbnail prompt
tips.body: Script Writer gives you a thumbnail prompt with every script. Paste it into the Thumbnail Generator as a starting point.

tips.title: Reuse prompts that worked
tips.body: In Assets, open a thumbnail you like and press Use prompt to keep a consistent look across your channel.

tips.title: Choose the model for the job
tips.body: Free models are great for drafts and ideas; switch to a pro model for the final thumbnail when detail matters.

tips.title: Pick a hook style
tips.body: Script Writer offers hooks like Direct & Fast, Mystery and Contradiction. Try two and keep the opening that grabs you.

tips.title: Match the tone to the topic
tips.body: Emotional, Analytical, Comedic or Controversial: choose the tone that fits your audience and the story you're telling.

tips.title: Set the duration first
tips.body: Enter the target duration in seconds so the script fits the format: short and punchy for Shorts, deeper for YouTube.

tips.title: Write for the platform
tips.body: Choose YouTube, TikTok or Reels before generating: pacing and structure change with each platform.

tips.title: Be specific about the topic
tips.body: "5 habits that made me a more productive freelancer" beats "productivity". Specific topics give specific scripts.

tips.title: Follow the visual cues
tips.body: Scripts include visual cues. Use them as your shot list when you record.

tips.title: Read it out loud
tips.body: Read the script aloud before recording and cut any sentence you stumble on. Spoken language is shorter than written.

tips.title: Come back to past scripts
tips.body: Every script is saved in Script History, so you can reopen it whenever you're ready to record.

tips.title: Copy or export in one click
tips.body: Use Copy or Export on a finished script to move it to your teleprompter or editing notes.

tips.title: Schedule the recording right away
tips.body: Once the script is ready, add a recording session in the Content Planner so the idea doesn't sit in a drawer.

tips.title: Let the assistant open tools
tips.body: Ask the assistant for a thumbnail or a script: it answers with an action card that opens the right tool with your idea.

tips.title: Tune the assistant
tips.body: Open the chat settings to choose the model, temperature and response length. A lower temperature gives more focused answers.

tips.title: One topic per chat
tips.body: Start a new chat for each project. Shorter, focused conversations give the assistant clearer context.

tips.title: Brainstorm titles in bulk
tips.body: Ask the assistant for 10 title options for the same video, then pick and combine the best parts.

tips.title: Ask for feedback, not just content
tips.body: Paste your script or title and ask what would make it more engaging. A second opinion in seconds.

tips.title: Give context up front
tips.body: Tell the assistant your niche, audience and platform in the first message. Better context, better suggestions.

tips.title: Iterate instead of restarting
tips.body: If an answer is close but not right, ask the assistant to adjust it (shorter, more energetic) instead of starting over.

tips.title: Your video stays on your device
tips.body: The AI Video Analyzer & Smart Clipper works in your browser: only small keyframes are sent to the AI, never the video file.

tips.title: Tell it what the video is about
tips.body: Add a short description before analyzing. With context, the AI finds better moments, hooks and titles.

tips.title: Choose the platform first
tips.body: Pick where the clips will go: each platform has its own length rules and the suggested clips follow them.

tips.title: Fine-tune every clip
tips.body: Use the ±1 s buttons or drag the clip's edges on the timeline to trim exactly where you want.

tips.title: Move a clip on the timeline
tips.body: Press and hold the selected clip on the timeline until it lifts, then drag it to a new spot.

tips.title: Export vertical in one step
tips.body: Export a clip in 9:16 and the clipper centers and crops it for Shorts, TikTok and Reels.

tips.title: Keep the tab open while you work
tips.body: The video only lives in your browser tab: leaving the page discards the analysis, so finish exporting first.

tips.title: Use the suggested hooks
tips.body: Each analysis also suggests hooks, titles and hashtags. Copy them straight into your post.

tips.title: Draft tweets in seconds
tips.body: Post to X turns your idea into a draft tweet. Edit it, check the 280-character counter and publish when it sounds right.

tips.title: Connect your X account once
tips.body: Link your X account in Settings → Integrations to publish drafts directly from Creator Hub.

tips.title: Read the mood of a trend
tips.body: X Trend Research summarizes key themes and sentiment, so you know if a topic is exciting or controversial before you join in.

tips.title: Find who drives the conversation
tips.body: Trend results flag influential and active accounts. Engage with them to get your take seen.

tips.title: Reply to fans around the clock
tips.body: Connect Telegram or WhatsApp to the Community Bot and it answers your community following the behavior you set.

tips.title: Test your bot first
tips.body: Use the Community Bot Playground to try replies before your fans see them, and adjust the behavior until it feels right.

tips.title: Set sensible limits
tips.body: Give the Community Bot a daily reply limit so you stay in control of your credits.

tips.title: Announce every new video
tips.body: When a video goes live, draft a tweet about it with Post to X and share the link while it's fresh.

tips.title: Share to get likes and views
tips.body: Make an asset public and share its link: likes and views come from its public page.

tips.title: Filter your library
tips.body: In Assets, filter by images or videos to find what you need fast.

tips.title: Download the originals
tips.body: Download any image or video from Assets to edit it or upload it anywhere else.

tips.title: Learn from your top performers
tips.body: Check which assets get the most likes in the Likes & views widget, and make more of what works.

tips.title: Keep your library tidy
tips.body: Delete drafts you won't use so your best work is easy to find.

tips.title: Check the price before you run
tips.body: AI tools show what they'll cost before running. If your balance is too low, you'll know before anything is charged.

tips.title: Top up before you run out
tips.body: When your balance gets low the platform lets you know. Top up from Credits so a deadline never stops you.

tips.title: Some models cost nothing
tips.body: Some analyses are free with certain models. Compare the cost shown in each tool before you choose a model.

tips.title: Use Creator Hub in your language
tips.body: Switch between English, Spanish and Portuguese from the top bar or Settings. Your choice is saved to your account.

tips.title: Check your notifications
tips.body: The bell in the top bar collects session reminders, likes on your assets and account messages.

tips.title: Keep your profile up to date
tips.body: Set your name in Settings → Profile: it's how the dashboard greets you every day.
